rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You stand on the broad Avenue of the Gods in the city of Kir Drax'in.  To
your north is the corner of the grand stadium of Kir Drax'in.  The Avenue forms
a junction with the city wall road immediately to your west.  To your south,
there is an ivy-covered marble doorway set into an otherwise dull brick wall.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the far northwestern corner of the city of Kir Drax'in.
The wall road takes a corner here, to run against the wall to the east and
south, where it disappears through a slew of buildings and shadows. The city
arena dominates this section of the city, as well as your view to the south east.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are at the northern part of the wall that surrounds the city. To
the south lies the massive spire-topped temple, and to the east and west
the wall bends southward. The rough, chiseled stone of the wall rises
high above you, but to the east you can see a few treetops above the
bits of glass and pottery inset into the wall's top surface.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The stone wall to your north and east is barely off of the crude
cobblestone road on which you stand. To the southwest rises the back
wall of the temple, and to the west you can see this road turn to
the south where it meets the city rampart.

rooms.name: At the Temple Altar
rooms.desc:
You stand before the temple altar. Carved from a solid block of black
marble, it is an exquisite example of dwarven craftsmanship. Black pillars
of the same marble hold up the ceiling of this open-aired pavilion, and to
the south a narrow aisle runs its way between hard oaken pews. There is a
small hand painted sign posted as well.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the narrow cobblestone wall road that surrounds the
city of Kir Drax'in.  The high city walls tower over your head to the west
and the walls and columns of the arena block your way east.  The city wall
road continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The cobblestoned wall road runs north and south between the high ramparts
that compose the city wall of Kir Drax'in and the white washed walls and
crumbling marble columns of the Kir Drax'in Arena. Despite being narrow and
slightly unacommodating, the streets here look clean, safe, and relatively
well trafficked.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The long wall road continues here, bordered by the wall city ramparts
to your immediate west and the stone walls and marble columns of the
ancient stadium to your east.  You may follow the road as it runs along
the wall to the north or south.

rooms.name: Temple of the Cross
rooms.desc:
The city's citizens file in to this large open pavilion once a week for
mandatory worship, but now it is quiet except for some battered adventurers
and their healers.  The main temple and the altar are to your north.  To
the south lies the city's main road, and sounds of the crowds there float
into this quiet place.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The road runs east and north here, and connects to the south onto the
Street of Wizardry. To the southwest the graceful yet ominous spires of
the city temple loom over you, and a smaller tower to the south rises
above the roof of the shop blocking your vision to the southeast.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The road beneath your feet follows the the rough grey stone of the city
wall that blocks your passage to the north. To the east you see it turn
southward, while just west of here it intersects with a busier street.  To
the southwest a well-fortified tower projects into your view of the temple.

rooms.name: Northeastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The street runs south and west here, bordered to the north and east by
the city ramparts that keep the beasts of the forest and invading forces
out of Kir Drax'in. Just to the southwest, a large black crystal temple
rises high, it's shiny mirror-like surface a stark contrast to the rough
stone around it. Off to the west, you can see the larger city temple, 
which is partially obscured from view by a sturdy-looking tower.

rooms.name: Mage Mastery Room
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a large, high-ceilinged room which is well lit by
hundreds of candles, which have been mounted on every available surface.
The sheer number of candles in this room is dwarfed only by the sheer number of
books, which fill the high bookcases mounted on all six walls of this chamber.
In the centre of the room a large glyph has been etched permenantly into the
stone floor, its edges marked by continually lit candles.

rooms.name: Warrior Practice Room
rooms.desc:
This lonely stone barracks is where young men whose families are not wealthy
enough to buy them positions in the Holy Guard go to be trained in the art of
combat.  This school is famous for educating some of the most notorious rebels
and mercenaries in history.  So famous in fact that the Holy Guard has even
begun sending acolyte paladins here for the specific training only a
mercenary school can offer.

rooms.name: Entrance to Mage Guild
rooms.desc:
This is the entrance to a very magical and playful place.  Wizards from
all around the land come here to keep up with their skills as is evident
from the many mages who stroll by, their various clothing styles betraying
their multiple origins.

rooms.name: Entrance to Warrior Guild
rooms.desc:
This room has very spartan decorations.  It seems that every time they put
something nice up, it gets stolen, so they stopped trying after a bit.  To
the north is the studio chamber of the Master of the Warrior Art.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk down the narrow perimeter road that runs the length of the walls
of Kir Drax'in.  To your east the road merges with the broad Avenue of the
Gods and to your south you can see the bustle that surrounds the western
gate of the city.  The wall road leads north from here running between the
city wall and the walls of the Arena.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
The grand concourse of the Avenue of the Gods ends abruptly to the
east, where it merges with the city wall of Kir Drax'in.  The Avenue
continues in all its splendor west towards the Temple Square.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are walking down a side road that serves as the boundary between the
city of Kir Drax'in and the thick walls that protect it.  This section of
road winds its way north and south through the temple district.  Ahead of you,
an arch has been erected over the road, to serve as a buttress between the
city wall, and a particularly weak looking building with a slated sloping roof.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The wall road makes a corner just to the north of here, turning to run
west towards the city centre.  You are at the edge of the temple district,
where practioners of lesser faiths keep their houses of prayer.  This area of
the city is well cleaned and well guarded.  You feel safe here, even on the
dim, twisty wall road.  The temple district continues to the south.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow cobblestone road which separates the city of Kir
Drax'in from the high ramparts that protect it.  The tall stone tower to
your southwest seems to mark the edge of the temple district.  You notice
that the buildings here change from ornate structure to more dull, sterile
buildings that are a hallmark of a modern city.  The wall road runs east
and west.

rooms.name: Temple Square
rooms.desc:
This large square marks the intersections of the Avenue of the Gods which
leads east and west, and Main Street which heads south.  North of here lies
the Temple of the Cross.  The entrance to the temple appears to be an atrium
surrounded by massive columns of marble with ornate carvings.  The sounds
of the city bring noise from all directions.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the narrow perimeter road which surrounds the city of Kir
Drax'in.  Further to the west, the perimeter road intersects with a broader
street running south, and also continues on to the west.  You are just to
the north of a large stone tower which is decorated with flags inscribed
with mystic symbols.  The wall road leads east and west.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the northern perimeter road of Kir Drax'in. There is
relatively little traffic here, as the wall road is usually only used by guard
patrols and servants on errands.  There seem to be many scantily glad girls
walking along the wall road though, which makes you think that people may be
doing other kinds of errands here as well.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the wall road which separates the city of Kir Drax'in from
the towering bulwark that protects it.  The road is especially narrow here
as it passes between the city wall and the walls of the arena.  This road
must be for pedestrian traffic only.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The wall road extends to the north and south from here.  You are
beginning to feel a little bit of claustrophobia from being in between the
high city walls to your west and the tall buildings to your east.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the road that runs along the perimeter of Kir Drax'in.
To the south you can hear the crowd on Market Street, as well as the bellows
of the guards at the eastern gate.  The wall road intersects to the west with
the Avenue of the Gods, and continues its path around the city to your north.

rooms.name: A Dimly Lit Hallway
rooms.desc:
This hallway has no windows, and is only dimly lit by candles.  You get
the feeling that this is a very holy place.  To your south there is an
archway that looks like it has been carved out of solid gold! The only
other exit is the follow the hallway to the north, where it meets a vestibule.

rooms.name: The Star Tavern
rooms.desc:
Despite its reputation, the Star Tavern seems mostly vacant, its few patrons
are hollow eyed, elderly souls who dwell in the decrepit housing on this side
of the city.  As you survey the delapitated tavern, you notice several shifty
characters walking in and out of a room located down a short hallway in back
of the tavern.  Wonder what could be going on in there?

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the road that runs the length of the western wall of
Kir Drax'in. Looking to the north and south, you can see roads heading away 
from Wall Road to the east. Also, you can see the western gates of Kir Drax'in 
just south of here.

rooms.name: Holy Room Of Clerics
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a beautiful sanctum.  Plain white walls and pillars offer
a simple contrast to the polished black marble of the floor.  There is a
brilliant fresco on ceiling that lends a sense of calm and beauty to this
holy place.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on a street running from the Temple of the Cross to your north
to the city gates of Kir Drax'in far to the south.  East of here is the front
entrance to a well-lit inn.  Temple Square is just to your north, and the
Market Square is just to your south.

rooms.name: The Back Room
rooms.desc:
This room resembles a pawn shop more than it does the back room of a tavern.
High shelves line the walls filled with all manner of objects, most of which
you immediately covet upon seeing.  There is a large oak table in the centre of
the room, obviously used to plan for jobs.  There are a number of crudely drawn
maps on the table, held down on one side by a set of climbing hooks and on the
other by a large bottle clearly marked with the word "Poison".

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the eastern wall road of Kir Drax'in.  To the south scores
of people mill about the eastern gates while the church guards frantically
attempt to maintain order over those coming and going through the gates.
The narrow wall road leads off to the north.

rooms.name: The Apothecary's Shop
rooms.desc:
Bottles of all shapes and colors adorn this shop. The stench coming from
a rack of corked vials near the door makes you nauseous, and you hurry about
your business. There's a large SIGN on the wall.

rooms.name: Lawana's Mystical Devices
rooms.desc:
Scrolls and various other magical items are lying on the counter here.
You wonder why the shopkeeper is not afraid that you will steal these
valuable items, but then thinking about all of the wizards you have seen
in the past, you come to a quick decision not to touch anything.
There is a large hand painted sign on the back wall.

rooms.name: Bakery
rooms.desc:
You think that something terribly wrong must have gone on here.  There is 
flour EVERYWHERE, as though several sacks of the white powder exploded.  A
large sign on the wall catches your eye.

rooms.name: Jack's Armor Shop
rooms.desc:
Various pieces of broken and new equipment sit all around this room.  
Some of it looks pretty interesting, and some of it looks pretty ordinary.
You wonder which you will get swindled into buying. A large sign on the 
wall catches your attention.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Records Office
rooms.desc:
This large office looks more like a library than a place of business,
there are shelves upon shelves of heavy looking books and paper files, all
indexed in accordance with some arcane filing system which only the old
clerks which inhabit this office understand.  This is where the church
keeps the complete record of every legal inhabitant of Kir Drax'in, from
birth to death.

rooms.name: Leon's Leathers
rooms.desc:
Leather armor in various states of assembly is here.  Most of it looks
to be superb armor that allows freedom of movement.  A large sign on the
wall catches your attention.

rooms.name: Western Gate
rooms.desc:
You stand before the western gate of Kir Drax'in, where the walls that
protect the city part wide enough to allow the ancient stone road from
the west to merge with the Market Street, which begins to form to your
east.  Guards from the church stand ever-vigilant by the gates, inspecting
each cart, beast and traveler with great care as they pass by.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
You stand in the middle of the Market Street of the city of Kir Drax'in.
Hoards of people, humans and elves mostly, swarm about to the calls of the
street vendors who fill almost every possible spot on the side of the
street with their wares.  Somewhere in the distance you can hear the sounds
of festive music playing.  The Market Street continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are on the western part of Market Street. To the south, you see a
restaurant from which you smell the savory scent of barbecued ribs and
beef.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are on the western part of Kir Drax'in's Market Street. To the
north, you see Jack's Armor Shop, while to the south, you see a shady
tattoo parlor.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are on the western part of Kir Drax'in's Market Street.  The cries
of the vendors around you assault your ears.  This section of the market
appears to be dominated by fruitmongers, hawking their fresh produce.
There is a large, warehouse-like building to the south, with wide doors. 
The market seems to continue inside the building, as well as to the west
and east down Market Street.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
Just west of Market Square, you are surrounded by shops and restaurants.
South of here is a general store, and to the north stands a well-fortified
shop housing what appears to be a jewelry merchant.

rooms.name: Market Square
rooms.desc:
This busy square lies in the heart of the city.  Travelers come from
miles around to drink from the magical fountain here and explore the
splendors of the surrounding streets.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
This is the eastern side of the wide Market Street in Kir Drax'in.  To the
north, you see a small bakery.  To the south there is a weapons shop, and
further to the east lies a vast array of vendors and booths.  The Market
Square is just to your west.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
This is the beginning of the eastern side of the main road that runs
through Kir Drax'in.  To the north there is a large, quaint shop that
looks busy.  A sign with the words "Records Office" embossed on it
hangs over the doorway.  To the south is a large wall made from stone
and mortar that is covered with advertisements and other paper fliers.
Market Street continues to your east, and the Market Square is just
to your west.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
To the north lies a busy shop packed with bolts of leather and raw hides
of various animals. To the south, an elegant shop with magic-runed columns
houses the identifier. The street continues on in both directions.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
You are walking down the busy Market Street in Kir Drax'in.  There are
a plethora of vendors set up on the streets and sidewalks here, although
you notice that the bulk of the activity seems to be to the west of here,
towards the Market Square.  A large granite building to the south houses the
Kir Drax'in bank.

rooms.name: Eastern Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the eastern gate of the great city of Kir Drax'in,
where the massive defensive wall that forms the city's perimeter opens
enough to allow passage for the steady stream of people who go in and out
of the city at all hours of the day.  The bustle of the Kir Drax'in Market
begins just west of here, and to the north and south a narrow wall road
leads to other sections of the city.

rooms.name: Berzerker's Tattoos
rooms.desc:
This room is very messy, with hundreds of small pictures covering the walls
and dried blood-spots all over the ground. An evil-looking chair sits in the
middle of the room, giving the room a strange malevolent look to it. A small
tray next to the chair has all sorts of sharp tools on it.

rooms.name: A Makeshift Shop
rooms.desc:
Some traveling clerics have set up shop here, donating accumulated items to 
the needy of Kir Drax'in.  The general consensus around town is that this is 
the only good thing that the church has brought to the city in it's new reign.

rooms.name: Dry Goods Store
rooms.desc:
This is a large general supply store.  Hundreds of essential items are
stacked neatly on the pine shelves that stretch from floor to ceiling.
This shop seems to attract many travelers and adventurers like yourself,
who are doubtless stocking up for long journies.

rooms.name: Darek's Happy House of Cutlery
rooms.desc:
Swords! Swords! SWORDS! There are so many weapons in this shop that you
wonder why this guy is just a shopkeeper and not Captain of the Guard. After
a quick talk of prices, you decide he makes more money selling things than
the entire regiment makes in a week by protecting you.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Bank
rooms.desc:
The Bank of Kir Drax'in, like nearly everything else in the city, is
ordained and controlled by the church.  The bank itself is rather typical
of church architecture, built with strong granite walls and kept tidy in
appearance.  The bank appears to be staffed mainly by old priests and young
acolytes, but you see a few women walking about, indicating that there must
be some type of secular position available here.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The wall road which creates a defensive perimeter around the city of
Kir Drax'in often times resembles a dark alley more than a road through
a modern city.  The western city gate and guard checkpoint are just to
the north of here, while the wall road continues to the south.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the perimeter road which winds its way around the city of
Kir Drax'in.  This section of the city shows signs of age and poor maintenance,
many of the buildings here look old and decrepit.  However, to your west a
section of building looks like it has been newly replastered and converted
into a garrison.  The harrow wall road winds its way to the north and south.

rooms.name: Southern Central Square
rooms.desc:
Once, this square must have been a beautiful gathering place for the early
citizens of Kir Drax'in.  Now, a few scant algae-ridden inches of water is all
that remains in the broken fountain, and the ceramic tiles that must have
once been so beautiful have been ripped up from the ground and smashed by
countless vandals.  This square, just like the entire Southern District, seems
to have fallen into disrepair.

rooms.name: Southwestern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
This is the southwest corner of the wall road that runs the perimeter
of Kir Drax'in.  Some garbage and other refuse has been piled into a corner
here, and the walls look as though they were blackened by a fire long ago.
The narrow and dimly lit wall road leads to the north and east.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The narrow wall road here is framed to the north by the backside of ancient
stone buildings and to the south by the high city wall.  The crowd in this
part of town is less than aristocratic.  The infamous Star Tavern is housed
in a crumbling structure to the north, home of the infamous Kir Drax'in
thieves guild.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The street head due east and west here, parallel to the city wall that
rises south of you.  You have a strong sense of claustrophobia walking this
road, the ancient crumbling buildings on one side of you, the colossal
city wall on the other.

rooms.name: Southern Gate
rooms.desc:
You are standing before the large gate to the city.  The portcullis looks 
strong and large, but it looks like the lock isn't in that great of condition. 
The guards watch you with searching eyes.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are walking upon the road that runs parallel with the wall that surrounds
the city of Kir Drax'in.  To the north the bleak image of the Kir Drax'in dump 
assaults your eyes and nose.  The wall road runs to the east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk along the wall road in the southern district of Kir Drax'in. Most
of the buildings in this district are in advanced stages of ruin, many of these
building's foundations predate the construction of the massive city wall which
towers above your head to the south.  To the north there is a relatively clean
building which serves as the city stables.  The wall road continues to the
east and west.

rooms.name: Southeastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The wall forms its southeastern corner here, and the perimeter road bends
around to accommodate it.  Standing at this junction, you wonder which came
first, this narrow road with its scuffed cobblestones, or the mighty wall
which towers above your head.  There is a thick smog in the air here that
carries the smell of burning pitch. The perimeter road continues to the north
and to the west.

rooms.name: Entrance to Kir Drax'in
rooms.desc:
You stand just outside the southern gates of Kir Drax'in.  This looks
like it is the least-used entrance to the city, despite the fact that the
trade road that runs to the south is well maintained and profitable for
the merchants that use it.  The southern walls of the city seem strong but
well-tested - it looks as if there was a large fire outside them some time ago
and the damage was never repaired, leaving the exterior surface charred and
burnt.  The guard checkpoint here seems to be deserted, although you can
see a small garrison of guards doing customs duty on the inside of the gate.

rooms.name: Entrance to Inn of Kir Drax'in
rooms.desc:
Not a very ornate entrance for an inn of this size, but it'll do for a
night of rest. Up some stairs you see the glowing light of the reception,
and to the east a dark doorway frames an inviting pub.

rooms.name: Inn Lobby
rooms.desc:
This sparse lobby is closed off from the rest of the building by a stout
iron door, obviously designed for keeping out unwanted guests.  The only
exit is down a flight of stairs to the ground floor.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the far western end of the Avenue of the Gods. The
roar of the crowds in the large stadium to your north is nearly deafening.
South of here, an ivy covered wall blocks your path. The avenue continues
to the east.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
Most of the people on this part of the avenue seem to be heading either
to or from the entrance of the large stadium to your north.  The enormous
building is made mostly of marble and is an awe-inspiring sight to behold.
South of here, an ivy covered wall blocks your passage. The avenue continues
to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a wide street with crowds of people wandering around
in all directions. It's a wonder that anyone gets anywhere in this traffic.
North of here, a huge stadium looms over you, while to the south, an ivy
covered wall blocks your way.  The avenue continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
Stretching out to the east and west of you is Kir Drax'in's famous Avenue
of the Gods. The statues lining the street are large and forbidding. South
of here, a sign the says "Post Office of Kir Drax'in" hangs over a small
building. To the north, you see the outer wall of the guard's barracks.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
This wide road is decorated on both sides by huge life-like statues of
the gods and goddesses of the world. The cobblestones beneath your feet
are old and worn, but well tended. To the south, you see the entrance to
a building set up to help those in need. To the east, you see Temple
Square, intersection of Main and the Avenue of the Gods. To the north,
the Street of Swords runs between the temple and the guard's barracks.
   The avenue continues to the west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are standing on Kir Drax'in's illustrious Avenue of the Gods.
Religious statues, built to larger-than-life size, decorate parts of
the street sides.  West of here, you can see Temple Square, which 
marks the intersection of Main Street and the Avenue of the Gods. To
the north, you can see the beginning of the Street of Wizardry.  The
avenue continues to your east and west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
This small avenue is decorated with many statues of the various gods and
goddesses worshiped by the people of Kir Drax'in. The detail of these huge,
larger-than-life-sized statues is absolutely amazing. To your north is the
renowned Kir Drax'in zoo.
   The avenue continues to the east and west while the side of an eclipsing
building blocks your passage southward.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are walking along the famous Avenue of the Gods, home to the temples
and religious organizations of Kir Drax'in. The giant statues that loom along 
the sides of the road make you want to bow down and pray to the gods they 
represent. A huge building made of some sort of shiny black rock lies to your
north while a humble dwelling filled with black-garbed mercenaries lies to
the south.
   The road continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are walking down the famous Avenue of the Gods, home to the temples
and religious organizations of Kir Drax'in. The giant statues that loom along 
the sides of the road make you want to bow down and pray to the gods they 
represent.  The entrance to a huge building made of some sort of shiny black 
rock lies to your north while to the south, an ivy-covered wall marks the back
sides of several tall buildings.
   The road continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Avenue of the Gods
rooms.desc:
You are walking down the famous Avenue of the Gods, home to the temples
and religious organizations of Kir Drax'in.  The statues that loom along
the sides of the road make you want to bow down and pray to the gods they 
represent.  A huge building made of some sort of shiny black rock lies to
your north, while to the south, a marble-faced tower houses the Psionicist
guild.
   The road continues to the west, and stops just to the east at the city
wall.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow cobblestone road that runs the perimeter of the city.
The road here on the west side of the city runs between the city walls and
the Kir Drax'in stadium.  It looks as if the wall road comes to a junction
up ahead to the north, and it continues its passage between the two high
walls to the south.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The perimeter road the surrounds the city runs east and west here, between
the towering northern city wall and the white walls of the city arena.  The
street here is mostly deserted, its only occupants being guards on patrol or
people hurrying on their way to someplace else.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The wall road twists here to avoid a large chunk of stone that the cities
builders must have been unable to remove.  It looks as if something was once
etched into the flat surface of the stone, but time and the elements have
taken their toll, leaving the markings illegible.  The city wall looms above
you to your immediate north, and the white washed walls of the arena are to
your south.  The narrow wall road leads east and west.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the narrow wall road that separates the city proper
from the massive protective walls that tower over your head to the west.
The Kir Drax'in Arena is directly to your east, although you can't see an
entrance from here.  The wall road continues south where it merges with a
broader concourse, and continues to wind its way along the wall to the
north.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on the busy Market Street of Kir Drax'in. The street continues
to the east and west, filled with vendors hawking various wares and lined
with many shops of exotic items. To the south you notice a large number of
guards and scummy thieves wandering in and out of the jail.

rooms.name: The Dump
rooms.desc:
The dump is relatively clean due the natural hot springs and contained
pool of churning molten rock that incinerates everything dropped here.  The
heat here is blistering.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Post Office
rooms.desc:
The Kir Drax'in post office is a tidy shop with a hard stone floor and
pine walls.  Various city dwellers move in and out of the post office without
paying you much heed, intent as they are in sending or receiving their mail.
You notice that the only people actually using the postal system are either
merchants, members of the church, or foreigners.  The workers and commoners
in the city simply haven't the money or need for the post office.

rooms.name: Entrance to Kir Drax'in
rooms.desc:
You stand just outside of the western gates of the city of Kir Drax'in
where the remnants of an ancient cobblestone highway slowly blend into
the streets of a large city.  The gates remain open nearly all the time
now, but the scarred exterior surface of the city walls tell a tale of
a time when that wasn't always the case.  A large contingent of armored
guards inspects all travelers wishing to pass through the gate into the
city to the east, and the ancient cobblestone highway leads off into the
countryside to the west.

rooms.name: Eastern Entrance To Kir Drax'in
rooms.desc:
You are standing just outside of the eastern entrance of Kir Drax'in.
The road here is wide and well-maintained, and runs west through the gate
and east into a lush pine forest.  There is a guarded checkpoint on both 
sides of the gate, controlling the flow of traffic in and out of the city.

rooms.name: Harga's House of Ribs
rooms.desc:
This restaurant is packed with people - amazing considering how messy it
looks.  You're almost afraid to see the food.

rooms.name: Tyr's Pub
rooms.desc:
A carved ironwood bar takes up the center of this room, and several sturdy
tables, well nicked by knife points, stand around it. Light trickles in from
the exit to the west, and oil lamps hang suspended in the corners of the room.
The smell of fresh ale fills the air.

rooms.name: A Burning Hut
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a burning hut; what you considered home until a few moments
ago when the orcs entered the village. You slept soundly until it was too
late; only the horrified screams of your parents dying woke you.
Now you stand bravely, though petrified with fear in your mind, as you watch
the hairy, tusked orcs advance toward you, swords in hand.

rooms.name: The Street of Swords
rooms.desc:
The Street of Swords reaches a concourse with the wide Avenue of the Gods
just south of here.  This area of the city is home to mostly mercenaries and
their guilds, although it is also the home of the Kir Drax'in Holy Guard.
The largest temple in the city, the Temple of the Cross, is just up a flight
of white marble steps to your east.  The Street of Swords runs north from
here.

rooms.name: The Street of Swords
rooms.desc:
The crowds walking north and south along this road are mostly men and
women equipped with swords and a wide variety of other weapons.  You can
recognize the large building to the west as the guard's barracks, home
to the city guard that oversees the Church's rule of Kir Drax'in.

rooms.name: The Street of Swords
rooms.desc:
Walking along the Street of Swords, you hear the sounds of clashing swords
coming from all directions.  Sometimes, the weapons practice gets so ferocious
they break out into brawls that often spread out onto the street. Best to be
cautious around here.

rooms.name: The Street of Swords
rooms.desc:
The large building to the west that houses the city guard runs the full
length of the Street of Swords. To the east, you hear the sounds of weapon
upon weapon emanating from the Warrior's Guild. The road continues to the
south.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc:
You are in the section of Kir Drax'in dedicated to the magical practioners
who live in the city.  This narrow road is lined on both sides with various
shops and other buildings housing establishments of mystical nature.  South
of here, the street merges with the Avenue of the Gods.  To the west, wide
steps lead up to the Temple of the Cross.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc:
You are walking down the Street of Wizardry, in the heart of the temple
district.  The walls of the Cross temple boarder the street to the west, while
to the east an exotic-looking curio shop resides in a low brick building.
The narrow cobblestone street continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc:
Colorful clouds of gases pour out of the apothecary to the west, drifting
up and down the street and burning your nostrils with their acrid odor. The
worn cobblestone street is black here from the heavy traffic that grinds the
soot and dirt into the stone. To the east rises a small tower, and you see 
mages of every alignment going in and out.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc:
Soot and smoke from the apothecary to the southwest settle here, turning
the street a dirty brown. A tower to the southeast rises slightly higher
than the city wall which lies up the street to the north. From the many-
hued robes of the citizens visiting the tower, you surmise it must be the
guild of mages.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc: You are in an unfinished room.

rooms.name: In the Stables
rooms.desc:
The smell of fresh dung greets your nose as you step into this
well-kept stable.  You can see many fine breeds of horses stored in
the extensive boarding area in front of you, but this front room looks
more like a country store than a stable, complete with a smiling hick
ready to take your money.  There is a small sign nailed to a post here.

rooms.name: stable room, do not delete
rooms.desc: stable room

rooms.name: Guard Barracks
rooms.desc:
This dimly lit room houses off-duty guards who don't feel the need to go
home to their families.  A stack of cards lie on a wobbly table, and a few
dirty cots line the wall.

rooms.name: The Emerald Aisle
rooms.desc:
You stand inside the Emerald Aisle, Kir Drax'in's famed jewelry exchange.
People from all over come here to buy and sell rare and beautiful jewels and
gemstones.  The display cases are full of exquisite stones and lavish jewelry.
Several jewelers sit behind the cases, examining stones and assisting the
many customers who mill about the shop.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are traveling along the wall road that defines the perimeter of
the city of Kir Drax'in.  The massive city walls rise high above your head
to the west and the walls of crumbling brink and mortar buildings block
passage to the east.  The wall road continues to your north and south.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along the wall road that is the perimeter of the city 
of Kir Drax'in.  Part of the mortar casing of the city wall has broken off
here, revealing the bare stones underneath.  The wall road continues to
the north and south.

rooms.name: An Elegant Shop
rooms.desc:
This well-lit shop has walls covered in various ancient drawings and
tapestries. A shelf of books behind the counter is filled with texts that
must date back to the dawn of writing.  A large sign hangs over the shelf.

rooms.name: Kir Drax'in Jail
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside the Kir Drax'in Jail. To the north lies the busy city
street, but in here all is quiet except for a few prisoners bemoaning their
fate. The main holding cell is south.

rooms.name: The Main Holding Cell
rooms.desc:
This is the main holding cell of prisoners who have disobeyed the city's
violence ordinances. Though the scenery isn't very exciting, it sure beats
the city's old penalty of death for lawbreakers.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
A proliferation of dingy buildings block your way to the south, and this
narrow street runs right against the city ramparts to the north. The road
follows the wall east and west along the northern perimeter of the city, the
bulk of which lies to the southwest. There you can see a solid-looking tower
flanked by two temples, one topped with ornate spires, the other seemingly
made of black crystal.

rooms.name: Northern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
A proliferation of dingy buildings block your way to the south, and this
narrow street runs right against the city ramparts to the north. The road
follows the wall east and west along the northern perimeter of the city, the
bulk of which lies to the southwest. There you can see a solid-looking tower
flanked by two temples, one topped with ornate spires, the other seemingly
made of black crystal. To the east the road turns south and follows the wall.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the perimeter road that runs along the wall of
Kir Drax'in.  You are definitely in the temple district of the city, as
evidenced by the elaborate reliefs on the buildings. You can smell the
heavy scent of incense coming from several windows and doorways along the
road, which winds its way to the north and south.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The walls of the building to your west are smooth and clean, belonging
no doubt to a temple of some faith.  There are long, narrow windows, but they
are set too high for you to see inside.  The wall road appears to intersect
with a broader concourse to your south, and wind its way though the back-ways
of the city to your north.

rooms.name: The Street of Wizardry
rooms.desc:
The street is little more than an alley here, running between the high
granite walls of the temple courtyard to the west and the back of a sturdy
wooden shop to the east.  North of here lies the insurmountable city wall,
while to the south you see the street is a bit more populated, though hazy
with smoke and fumes.

rooms.name: Western Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You are walking down the western wall road of Kir Drax'in.  There seems
to be a lot of trash and refuse piled up along the road here, as if the
city doesn't send workers down here to clean regularly.  You notice that
the quality of the buildings here is quite poor despite Kir Drax'in being
a prosperous city.  Most of the buildings here are crumbling tenements
whose residents live in poverty.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk along the narrow wall road which forms a perimeter between the
city of Kir Drax'in and the thick wall that protects it.  Trash and refuse
line the sides of the street here, and the cobblestones are slick with slime
and grease.  The wall road continues to your east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on a narrow cobblestone road that runs the perimeter of the
city of Kir Drax'in.  This section of the city looks like one of the oldest
and certainly one of the most decrepit.  Trash and refuse from the crumbling
buildings line the sides of the narrow road, and scores of indigent people
huddle in open foyers and doorways on either side of the road.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk along the cobblestoned wall road.  The road bends and twists
occasionally, accounting for differences in the wall and the buildings
which doubtless predated it.  Here, some religious soul has drawn a large
symbol of faith in white chalk on the side of a crumbling tenement.
The perimeter road continues to your east and west.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on Main Street in Kir Drax'in which bisects the city.  There is
a well-populated square to your north, and you can vaguely make out the
southern gates of the city down the street to your south.  This is the edge
of the city's aptly named Southern District, the oldest section of the city.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on a street running from the Temple of the Cross to the north
to the city gates of Kir Drax'in far to the south.  The cobbles in the road
appear a bit more worn here.  There is a newly constructed brick wall to 
the east with an opening in it.  The brick wall appears to run the length
of southern Main Street.
   To the north Main Street heads back to Market Square while to the south,
the road continues toward South Central Square.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You are on Main Street in the Southern District of Kir Drax'in.  The
buildings here are ancient, crumbling structures inhabited mostly by the poor
and the faithful.  The street here is bounded by two squares - a bustling one
to the north, and a quiet one just south of here.

rooms.name: Main Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on a street running from the Temple of the Cross to the north
to the city gates of Kir Drax'in far to the south.  This was once part of
the old city, now blocked off by a brick wall. 
Southern Central Square is just to the north while the southern city gate
lies to the south.

rooms.name: Eastern Market Street
rooms.desc:
You stand on the busy Market Street of Kir Drax'in. The street continues
to the east and west, filled with vendors hawking various wares and lined
with many exotic items.

rooms.name: Western Market Street
rooms.desc:
The sights, smells, and sounds of the Kir Drax'in market assault you
from all directions.  From here you can see that the center of the market
lies further to your east, while here nearer to the cities western gate
there is less of a crowd. Market Street continues to your east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The narrow cobblestone road that forces a boundary between the city of
Kir Drax'in and the thick walls that protect it winds its way east and west.
There seems to be a small square to the west, formed by the corner of the
city wall.  All the walls and cobblestones here have a thick layer of soot
and grime on them from the pitch fires that the poverty-stricken residents
of this section of town burn for warmth.  The smell of pitch hangs heavy
in the air, especially at night.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk along the narrow wall road in the south of Kir Drax'in. This
is one of the poorest areas in the city, but people would still prefer
to live here than risk life outside of the city walls.  The air here is
thick with smoke from the incinerator at the city dump not far from here.
The cobblestoned wall road continues to your east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The narrow wall road winds and twists its way against the thick city walls
which tower above your head.  The buildings in this section of the city are
crumbling husks for the most part, a mixture of over a millennia of 
architecture thrown haphazardly together.  The cobblestone road winds away
to the east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk down the narrow perimeter road that separates the city of
Kir Drax'in from the thick, towering walls that protect it from the outside
world.  There is a faded fresco on the wall of an old building to your north,
its beauty, thought faded, stands in sharp contrast to the bleakness around
you.  The perimeter road leads east and west.

rooms.name: Southern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
The cobblestone perimeter road runs to the east and west here, through an
ancient district of Kir Drax'in.  It is relatively quiet here, in comparison
to the bustle of the market and the city centre further to the north. The
cobblestones have been worn down particularly hard in this section of street,
allowing potholes to form in several places. The wall road runs to your east
where it reaches a junction, and west where it winding through more ancient
architecture.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You walk down the narrow cobblestone road that runs between the city and
the massive city wall.  To your north you can hear the bustle of what must
be the eastern gate of Kir Drax'in, as well as the market.  The road to the
south seems relatively quiet and unpopulated, although you do see several
sconces burning in the windows of some buildings.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
As you walk down the cobblestoned wall road you notice that the architecture
here seems to blend from old to new, as ancient tenements whose corner stones
likely predate the thick city walls give way to lighter more modern buildings
of plaster and stone.  Even the cobblestones on the road seem to be a mixture
of old and new, with scuffed, worn cobbles next to relatively new unworn ones.
The road continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
Walking down the perimeter road, you get the distinct feeling that the
city is changing around you.  To the north you can see the very modern city
of Kir Drax'in, with its lavish market street and temple district, while
further to the south the crumbling southern district of the city begins to
take hold. The winding cobblestone road continues in either direction.

rooms.name: Eastern Wall Road
rooms.desc:
You stand on the narrow perimeter road that runs the length of the city
of Kir Drax'in.  The eastern gate of the city is just to your north, and
from here you can see the constant flux of traffic that flows through it at
all hours of the day.  This cobblestone road runs south between the city
wall and tall buildings, which shade the road in an almost perpetual sort
of twilight.

rooms.name: Customs House
rooms.desc:
You stand in the centre of the large warehouse that is the Kir Drax'in
Customs House.  Although trade inside the city seems to be rather free
flowing as evidenced by the bustle of the Market Street, the church does
place levies and taxes on certain products, which must be registered for
sale through a customs inspector in this building.  The warehouse is
packed full of merchants and their wares, all waiting to get a seal of
approval from a church customs official.

rooms.name: An Alcove
rooms.desc:
This alcove was likely a shrine of some sort long ago, but now there are no
icons in the niches on either side of the small room, and the depression in the
floor that likely used to contain water is empty now.  There is a faded fresco
on the ceiling, its design rendered unintelligible by the ravages of time. Two
ivy-covered marble arches set in the north and south walls provide egress from
this former holy place.

rooms.name: A Private Garden
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small square garden which has been secreted away in a court
of this temple.  High above your head a glass skylight shield this garden from
the elements.  All of the flowers and trees look fresh and healthy, and the
air is magically cool.  You may leave the garden through an ivy-covered marble
arch to the north.

rooms.name: Temple Medical Centre
rooms.desc:
Part of the Church's rule of Kir Drax'in involves medical care for its
citizenry.  This medical centre is far from modern though, using only
church approved techniques and technology.  Understandably, the mortality
rate is very high.

rooms.name: The Morgue
rooms.desc:
This large room looks more like a butcher shop than a mortuary,
with thick, dried pools of blood and bits of gore stuck to the floor.
Obviously, the smell here is less than pleasant and carries a distinct
waft of chemicals.  The evil-looking man hunched over a shrouded body
may be your only hope of getting your possessions back, however.

rooms.name: Psionicist Antechamber
rooms.desc:
As you stand in this sparsely decorated foyer, you feel your mind
probed by many unseen Psionicists, perhaps even the guildmaster herself,
who lies in the room to the west.

rooms.name: Psionicist Guild
rooms.desc:
You stand in a cold, barren room whose wooden floor creaks loudly as you
step upon it.  The lighting is very poor here, you can vaguely make out the
outlines of unknown persons lying prone on the floor around you, apparently
in supplication.  The longer you spend here, the more you feel the crackling
of powerful energies coursing through your body.

rooms.name: Inside the Dojo
rooms.desc:
Light streams in from outside and refracts off the rice-paper walls,
turning the inside of this modest dwelling bright as day.  A few sparse
decorations -- a rack of katanas here, a painted scene of battle there,
a straw broom in the corner -- are all that decorate this place. 
   A doorway to the south marks the room of the guildmaster.

rooms.name: The Back Room
rooms.desc:
This airy room is separated from the entrance to the north by only a thin
rice-paper wall. A small fire pit has been dug in the dirt floor, over which
brews a pot of herb tea.  The room is barren of any permanent fixtures, with
the exception of several elaborate scrolls hung on the walls.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There is a large wall to the north and west, but
it looks like you can leave to the east or south.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There are walls to the north and east, but it
looks like you can leave to the west and the south.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  You seem to be able to leave in any direction.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There is a large wall directly to your east, but 
seem to be able to move north, west, or south.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There is a wall here to the west and north, but
you can leave to the east and south.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There are large walls to your west and south, but
you seem to be able to move north and east.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  You can exit the arena to the south, and you seem
to be able to move to the west, north, or east.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There are large walls to your south and east, but
you seem to be able to move north and west.

rooms.name: Eastern Vestibule
rooms.desc:
This vestibule is perfectly circular, with four marble columns supporting
the arched ceiling high above your head.  The floor here is made of perfect,
veinless white marble and inlaid with obsidian rings, forming a pattern of
concentric circles on the floor.  Ornate marble arches lead north, south,
and west.

rooms.name: Western Vestibule
rooms.desc:
This vestibule is perfectly circular, with four marble columns supporting
the arched ceiling high above your head.  The floor here is made of perfect,
veinless white marble and inlaid with obsidian rings, forming a pattern of
concentric circles on the floor.  Ornate marble arches lead north, south,
and east.

rooms.name: Temple Infirmary
rooms.desc:
This is a large room where the sick and the dying are cared for by the
nuns and priestesses of the Church.  There are about fifty straw beds arranged
in four rows here, and almost all of them are full.  Most of the patients are
either common citizens or foreigners; the military has their own infirmary
as do the large temples.  The wealthier citizens can afford an in-home visit
by a Church healer.  The entire room smells of medicinal soap.  There is
a single exit through a marble archway to the north.

rooms.name: Quiet Room
rooms.desc:
This is a quiet room, used by the priests and priestesses of the Cross
for prayer and meditation.  There is a large window in the northern wall
that looks out over the beautiful temple garden, but you can't see any way
to get to it from here.  A marble archway leads south from this room to
the eastern vestibule.
